parameters.name: DomainNames
parameters.description: The accelerated domain names whose configurations you want to delete. Separate multiple accelerated domain names with commas (,).

parameters.name: FunctionNames
parameters.description: The names of the features that you want to delete. Separate multiple feature names with commas (,). For more information about feature names, see [Feature settings for a domain name](~~410622~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn batch-delete-dcdn-domain-configs --domain-names example.com --function-names referer_white_list_set,https_force --region cn-hangzhou
